name: Rescue Roundup
summary: Wheeler asks you to bring his lost horse, Biscuit, back to Wheeler's Grange. Her return means the grange is back in business.

sections.title: Biscuit Returns
sections.body: Wheeler's lost horse is named Biscuit, and she bows her head before nudging your arm. You bring her back to Wheeler's Grange. Wheeler is grateful to have Biscuit home, though she expects the horse to be alone for a while. The grange is open for business again.

faq.answer: Biscuit is Wheeler's horse, who has been lost and needs to be brought back to Wheeler's Grange.

faq.q: Where does Biscuit need to go?
faq.answer: Biscuit needs to be brought back to Wheeler's Grange.
Wheeler is grateful because you bring Biscuit back to the grange.
Wheeler says Biscuit will be alone for a while and hopes to find some of her stable-mates.
With Biscuit back, Wheeler's Grange is back in business.
